description: Worked on multiple projects converting Figma designs to code, ensuring responsive and high-quality implementation. Collaborated with design teams to maintain pixel-perfect accuracy and implemented Storybook for component documentation.

Single-handedly developed a modern, fully responsive company website ensuring seamless performance across all devices. Implemented automated email system for contact notifications and achieved 95+ PageSpeed Insights score.

Developed user-friendly search webpage for efficient record retrieval and display. Customized Quill editor to improve user experience and added templating features. Reduced search response time by 40%.
